answer.action: Ensure compliance with e-mandate registration, AFA validation, pre and post-transaction notifications, and grievance redressal mechanisms for recurring payments.
answer.action_quote: The provisions of these Directions shall be applicable to all Payment System Providers and Payment System Participants in respect of processing of recurring transactions, domestic or cross-border, using cards / PPI / UPI.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be effective immediately.
